placements.note: Overlay on the circular desk's ledger; see NEEDS_ART.

elevator_closed.purpose: Records stop of the shared elevator, doors shut (Records recolour of the Orientation elevator set).

elevator_half.purpose: Elevator doors half open (arrival and departure).

elevator_open.purpose: Elevator doors open; the avatar steps out to the arrival cell.

door_panel_address_idle.purpose: Wall panel beside the repair door with two text windows and a visible cursor and deletion side; the level 07 interaction.

cabinet_gate_misaligned.purpose: Two file cabinets pushed crooked across the margin-room doorway (level 08 gate, closed).

cabinet_gate_aligned.purpose: The same cabinets squared up against the shelf line; the doorway is open (level 08 gate, open).

rolling_ladder_parked.purpose: Library ladder parked across the gallery doorway (level 09 gate, closed).

rolling_ladder_moved.purpose: The ladder rolled along its rail to the side, revealing the gallery doorway (level 09 gate, open).

cabinet_labels_offset.purpose: Cherry log cabinet, sea-blue folders with label tabs visibly offset (level 08, before).

cabinet_labels_aligned.purpose: The same cabinet with every label tab aligned on one line (level 08, after).

mail_chute_idle.purpose: Wall-mounted mail chute with a blinking intake light, Mira's landmark in Records.

mail_chute_active.purpose: The chute with its light steady and a slip in the slot (after level 11 the loop is open).

archive_ledger_mark_rejected.purpose: Small overlay on the circular desk's ledger: Noor's stamp mark as a rejection cross (levels 07 to 08). Can be cropped from archive_ledger_before.

archive_ledger_mark_accepted.purpose: The same overlay with a tick and a stamped seal (after level 08). Can be cropped from archive_ledger_after.

artifact_carbon_copy_a.purpose: Optional artifact stand: Carbon copy A, the first original route record (level 08).

artifact_margin_stamp.purpose: Optional artifact stand: Margin stamp on a ledger corner (level 09).

artifact_uncut_index.purpose: Optional artifact stand: Uncut index on a lectern (level 10).

artifact_noor_annotation.purpose: Optional artifact stand: Noor's annotation on the correction copy (level 11).

gates.visible_change: The repair door retracts and Noor steps out from behind the circular desk.
gates.locked_hint: The door panel asks for an address; the way back to the elevator stays open.

gates.visible_change: The offset cabinets square up against the shelf line and the margin-room doorway opens.
gates.locked_hint: Two cabinets sit crooked across the doorway; fix the log first.

gates.visible_change: The rolling ladder slides along its rail and uncovers the gallery doorway.
gates.locked_hint: A ladder is parked across the stairs to the gallery; the ledger room moves it.

gates.visible_change: The review chamber door slides open at the east end of the gallery.
gates.locked_hint: The review chamber door shows the long report; cite it to open it.

gates.visible_change: The sliding file wall opens a two-cell corridor from the review chamber to Mira's chute.
gates.locked_hint: The file wall closes the loop to Mira; it is visible from both sides.

zones.note: Arrival annex: entrance, elevator, repair door panel
Foyer and ring around the circular archive desk

interactions.label: Review chamber desk (late Courier Loop slip)

npcs.note: Noor follows the work. Posture ladder (the posture set plays once per cabinet step and holds its last frame): start and 07 hold posture_upright frame 0 (stooped), 07 outside the ring at the hub; 08 stamp-down (interact) in the margin room as the mark is accepted, then holds; 09 posture_upright frame 1 held, in the gallery; 10 a satisfied nod beside the original report, then waits in the review chamber; 11 base idle (fully upright) back at the hub. The hub talk interaction exists for the start position only; later lines arrive through dialogue conditions.
Absent until level 07 completes (interaction visible_when); the pocket shows the blinking chute before then.

backtrack.label: Review chamber back to the entrance the way you came (every gate stays open).
Review chamber straight down the opened file wall to Mira's chute.
Hub to the elevator arrival cell through the repair door.

notes: Collision is the initial state: every progression gate starts blocked and its cells are listed under gates.
Approach facing is the direction the avatar faces toward the target.
Lamp placements marked state off are the shelf-end, ledger, upper-desk and chute lamps; they wake through the light states in district.json.
